title: Green space targets and the OneMillionTrees movement
asked: Ms Poh Li San asked what proportion of land will be set aside for green spaces long term as Singapore urbanises, and how the OneMillionTrees movement is progressing.
response: Mr Alvin Tan said Singapore aims to add 1,000 hectares of green spaces by 2035, safeguarded in URA's Master Plan since 2019, and that over 7,800 hectares of green spaces are already protected, with 130 hectares of parks developed in the last five years. On tree planting, he said the one million tree target by 2030 is on track, with over 832,000 trees planted as of January 2026 and over 150,000 community participations. He also cited the Parks for Health Framework, 15 contemplative landscape sites and a goal of 30 therapeutic gardens by 2030, and said wind flow is factored into urban planning along with heat stress advisories.
